info.title: SNMPv3_User
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

access_level.description: ro - read-only access for snmpv3 user. rw - read-write access for snmpv3 user.

auth_pass_phrase.description: The key to be used by authentication protocol. This column value  can be empty. If not configured, no authentication pass-phrase is  associated with the SNMP v3 user.

auth_protocol.description: The authentication protocol to be used for authenticating the user. Users without authentication will be disabled when system  snmp_security_level is authPriv or authNoPriv.

enabled.description: Indicates whether this user is operational. User might be turned non-operational if it doesn't comply with the system snmp_security_level.

priv_pass_phrase.description: The key to be used by privacy protocol. This column value can be  empty. If not configured, no privacy pass-phrase is associated  with the SNMP v3 user.

priv_protocol.description: The privacy protocol to be used for encrypting the user requests. Users without privacy protocol will be disabled when system  snmp_security_level is authPriv

remote_engine_id.description: The SNMPv3 remote engine id in a colon separated hexadecimal  notation. Example 80:00:00:09:05:01:04:03:21. This column value  can be empty. This column is not in use.

snmp_view.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMP_View](#/SNMP_View)
SNMP view associated with a user. This column value can be empty. If not configured, no SNMP view is associated the user.

snmpv3_contexts.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMPv3_Context](#/SNMPv3_Context)
SNMPv3 contexts to be associated with the user, limited to 1 context per VRF.

user_name.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMPv3_User](#/SNMPv3_User)
User name that should contain alphanumeric characters.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
